scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:macos: swift build --package-path macos --target CaptureCoreTests && swift test --package-path macos --skip-build && pnpm run build:capture && pnpm run test:capture-bundle-process
scripts.build: bun build src/main/electron-entry.ts --outdir dist/main --target node --external electron && bun build src/auth/login-preload.ts --outdir dist/auth --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
